sites.editing: Click words to retype them, or reach them with Tab. Enter keeps them, Escape puts them back.
sites.pointing: Click a part of the page, or reach it with Tab and press Enter, then ask {name} about it.
sites.pointed: Pointing at this part: say in the box what to change
sites.notHere: These words can’t be changed here: the page has them more than once, or they don’t come from its file. Ask {name} to change them.
sites.onlyWords: Only the words change here, and none can be left empty: it’s back as it was.
sites.example: my bakery in the old town
sites.shape: Use 3 to 40 letters from a to z, digits and hyphens.
sites.held: This address is held back, so that nobody is mistaken about whose site it is.
sites.public: Anyone can open it, and search engines show it.
sites.year: Online for a year. Each publish renews it.
sites.formWaits: Its form can’t send replies yet.
sites.codeShape: Eight groups of four characters, 0 to 9 and A to F.
sites.wrongCode: This code doesn’t publish this address.
sites.keep: Keep this recovery code somewhere safe. With it, another device can publish this site again. Without this device or the code, nobody can change it.

sites.changed.one: {count} file changed since it was published.
sites.changed.other: {count} files changed since it was published.

sites.same: Nothing changed since it was published.
sites.confirmOffline: Take this site offline? Its address stays yours for a year.
sites.elsewhere: This site was published from another device. Type its recovery code to publish it from here.
sites.failed: The site couldn’t be published. Check your connection and try again.
sites.confirmNewCode: Make a new recovery code? The old code, and any device you removed, can no longer change this site. Your other devices get the new code.
sites.newCodeMade: The old recovery code no longer works for this site.
sites.newCodeFailed: No new recovery code was made. Check your connection and try again.
